articles.title: VirusTotal’s New Ransomware Detection Catches Malware Missed by All 75 Antivirus Engines
articles.summary:
VirusTotal has rolled out a ransomware detection update that checks whether suspicious files actually encrypt user documents during execution. The new checks caught a Python ransomware sample that recorded zero detections across 75 antivirus engines at the time of analysis, showing how behavior checks can expose threats that static scanning misses. The update spans VirusTotal […]
